name: Skip-Month Momentum Rotation — Metals & Mining
description: Long-only cross-sectional skip-month momentum rotation on 10 metals and mining stocks (NUE, STLD, X, CLF, AA, CENX, FCX, SCCO, TECK, RS). Signal: (close >> 21) / (close >> 252) - 1, which skips the most recent month to avoid short-term reversal. Selects top 3 stocks each month, equal-weighted at ~33.3% each. Rebalances on the first trading day of each month.
source:
# Skip-Month Momentum Rotation — Metals & Mining
#
# RULES:
# - Universe: 10 metals & mining stocks (NUE, STLD, X, CLF, AA, CENX, FCX, SCCO, TECK, RS)
# - Signal: Skip-month momentum = (close >> 21) / (close >> 252) - 1
#   Skips the most recent month to avoid short-term reversal effects
# - Selection: Top 3 stocks by skip-month momentum
# - Weighting: Equal weight (1/3 each, ~33.3% per position)
# - Rebalancing: Monthly (first trading day)
# - Long-only (no short leg)

# Data source - DAILY
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c

# Skip-month momentum: skips most recent 21 days (1 month), measures return from 252 days ago to 21 days ago
skip_mom = (close >> 21) / (close >> 252) - 1

# Cross-sectional selection: top 3 by skip-month momentum
# cs_select returns boolean mask: True for top 3 stocks
is_top_3 = cs_select(direction=CSSelectDirection.top, mode=CSSelectMode.count, k=3)(skip_mom)

# Detect first trading day of month
is_new_month = is_period_boundary(period=PeriodType.month)(index())

# Monthly rebalance signals
# Enter when stock enters top 3 at month start, exit when it leaves
enter_long = is_new_month and is_top_3
exit_long = is_new_month and not is_top_3

# Hold position until next month rebalance
held_signal = hold_until()(enter=enter_long, exit=exit_long)

# Entry/Exit zones
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held_signal)

# Equal weight across selected sectors
weights = equal_weight()(held_signal)

# Position sizing - ONLY rebalance on first trading day of month
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=weights * 100, rebalance_on=is_new_month)
